title: Ripple USD stablecoin page

notes: PR-028A primary overview source. Ripple states RLUSD is designed to maintain one U.S. dollar, is natively issued on XRP Ledger and Ethereum, is fully backed by cash and cash equivalents, and is redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars. Use separate terms/transparency sources for detailed legal and reserve treatment.
